governed.config: actionlint reads the project's .github/actionlint.yaml: the project decides the self-hosted runner labels, the config variables and the paths and error patterns to ignore

suppressions.description: none in the file: the tool has no in-file suppression; the ignore patterns live in .github/actionlint.yaml

en.label: actionlint (GitHub Actions)
en.purpose: Checks GitHub Actions workflow files for mistakes: workflow syntax, wrong expressions and contexts, unknown action inputs, bad job dependencies, and the shell and Python scripts inside run steps.
en.limitation: It checks the workflow's correctness, not its security (zizmor does that). It only looks at the files in .github/workflows; any YAML file it is given is read as a workflow.
en.needs: The tools image only (shellcheck and pyflakes for the scripts in run steps): no network and no project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: actionlint (GitHub Actions)
pt-BR.purpose: Verifica erros nos arquivos de workflow do GitHub Actions: sintaxe do workflow, expressões e contextos errados, entradas de ações desconhecidas, dependências de jobs inválidas e os scripts de shell e Python dos passos run.
pt-BR.limitation: Verifica a correção do workflow, não a segurança dele (o zizmor faz isso). Só olha os arquivos de .github/workflows; todo YAML recebido é lido como workflow.
pt-BR.needs: Apenas a imagem de ferramentas (shellcheck e pyflakes para os scripts dos passos run): sem rede e sem as dependências do projeto.
